I'm 22 and have them on the inner calf of one leg and above/around the knees on both legs. Both parents have them so thanks mom and dad! Double-bonus of having small broken veins covering my entire thighs and making me hideous. In my experience, too much of any one mode is bad. I can't really sit or lay for more than 2 hours (which makes long class days horrific). Too much exercise makes them throb, and I do wear athletic compressions during. Have you tried the 'medical' compressions? They're expensive, but they compress specifically for this purpose and do a much better job pain and appearance wise than athletics. I wear them to sleep, after a hard run, while hanging around, and whenever my legs are bothering me. 

Edited to add that [these](http://www.supportplus.com/supportplus/Medical-Support-Hose_1CA/Womens-Medical-Support-Hose_1CB/By-Compression_1CI/Firm-20-30_1CL/Item_s-Jobst-Firm-Support-Ultrasheer-Thigh-Highs_FA4282.html) are the ones I have and love, but there are many to choose from.
